title: A coproduct obstruction for derived unramified cohomology
summary: Let \(k\) be a perfect field of exponential characteristic \(p\), and let \(R\) be a commutative \(\Z[1/p]\)-algebra. We prove that the first derived unramified functor \[ F\longmapsto R^1_{\mathrm{nr},R}F \] from homotopy invariant Nisnevich sheaves with transfers of \(R\)-modules to birational sheaves commutes with arbitrary small direct sums. This gives a positive answer, after inverting the exponential characteristic, to a question of Kahn and Sujatha; on smooth projective varieties no inversion is needed.
